tools.name: API-getChatMessages
tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve recent chat messages from the authenticated user's channel

tools.name: API-postChatMessages
tools.description: Xeenon | Send a chat message to the authenticated user's channel (requires prior channel join via xeenon.xyz or mobile app)

tools.name: API-getChatByUserAddressMessages
tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve recent chat messages from a specific user's channel by their Solana address

tools.name: API-getContent
tools.description: Xeenon | Fetch Xeenon content including clips, videos, and streams with filtering options

creatorAddress.description: Filter content by creator Solana address

tools.name: API-getContentCategories
tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve all available Xeenon content categories for filtering and organization

tools.name: API-getLeaderboard
tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve Xeenon leaderboard rankings filtered by month or category

monthOffset.description: The month offset (1 = last month, 2 = 2 months ago, etc)

category.description: The category slug to get a specific category leaderboard

tools.name: API-postFollow
tools.description: Xeenon | Follow a user by their Solana address with notification preferences

newVod.description: Receive email notifications when the user uploads a new video

newStream.description: Receive email notifications when the user goes live

newVod.description: Receive in-app notifications when the user uploads a new video

newStream.description: Receive in-app notifications when the user goes live

address.description: The address of the user to follow

tools.name: API-deleteFollow
tools.description: Xeenon | Unfollow a user by their Solana address

address.description: The address of the user to unfollow

tools.name: API-getFollowFollowing
tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve list of users that the authenticated user is following

limit.description: The number of items to return

skip.description: The number of items to skip

tools.name: API-getFollowFollowers
tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve list of users who are following the authenticated user

limit.description: The number of items to return

skip.description: The number of items to skip

tools.name: API-getFollowContent
tools.description: Xeenon | Fetch content (clips, videos, streams) from users that the authenticated user follows

limit.description: The number of items to return

skip.description: The number of items to skip

tools.name: API-postReactions
tools.description: Xeenon | Add a like or dislike reaction to content (videos, clips, streams) or comments

modelId.description: The ID of the content to react to

modelType.description: The type of model to react to. `Content` if reacting to a video, clip or stream, `Reaction` if reacting to a comment

count.description: The number of likes (Only allowed when reaction to streams)

tools.name: API-deleteReactions
tools.description: Xeenon | Remove a previously added like or dislike reaction from content or comments

modelId.description: The ID of the model to remove reaction from

type.description: The type of reaction to remove

tools.name: API-postReactionsComments
tools.description: Xeenon | Post a comment on content (videos, clips) or reply to existing comments

modelId.description: The ID of the model to comment on

modelType.description: The type of model to comment on. `Content` if commenting on a video or clip, `Reaction` if replying to a comment

tools.name: API-getReactionsComments
tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve comments and replies for specific content with pagination support

tools.name: API-deleteReactionsCommentsById
tools.description: Xeenon | Delete a comment that was posted by the authenticated user

tools.name: API-patchReactionsCommentsById
tools.description: Xeenon | Edit the content of a comment posted by the authenticated user

tools.name: API-getSearchByModelType
tools.description: Xeenon | Search Xeenon users, clips, videos, streams, or categories

limit.description: The limit of the search results

skip.description: The skip of the search results

tools.name: API-postSseSigned-url
tools.description: Xeenon | Generate a signed SSE URL for establishing real-time event connections (URL remains valid until expiry; invalidating API key invalidates all associated signed URLs)

ttl.description: The TTL of the SSE URL in seconds. Omit to generate a signed URL that doesn't expire.

tools.name: API-getSseEvents
tools.description: Xeenon | Establish real-time Server-Sent Events connection to receive live updates from subscribed channels (user events, token activity). Authentication via token parameter, not X-API-Key header

channels.description: Comma separated list of channels to subscribe to.

tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve live streams filtered by category/subcategory (use onlyMyStreams=true to get only authenticated user's streams)

tools.description: Xeenon | Retrieve authenticated user's default stream settings including headline, description, and tags

tools.name: API-postStreamsSettings
tools.description: Xeenon | Update authenticated user's default stream settings (headline, description, tags) and apply to active streams
